name: Target-Material-Column Specification Registry
abstract: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification target-material-column definitions derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Hosts one $def per column of a per-target-material table. TAPP building blocks reference these definitions via fragment $refs so they resolve locally through the register.
annotatedSchema:
$schema: https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema
title: ADA Target-Material-Column Specification Registry
description: Registry of reusable schema:PropertyValueSpecification target-material-column
  definitions derived from technique TAPP spreadsheets. Each $def constrains one column
  of a technique's per-target-material table (e.g. beamCurrent, beamDiameter) - a
  field whose Keyed By column names `target material`, so its value repeats over the
  material types the procedure analyses. TAPP building blocks reference these definitions
  via fragment $refs (schema.yaml#/$defs/<name>) so they resolve locally through the
  building-block register. The root only hosts $defs; it has no instantiable properties
  of its own.
type: object
$defs:
  epma_backgroundCountingTime:
    title: Background Counting Time
    description: Total time spent counting at off-peak background position(s) in seconds,
      summed across all background positions.
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/backgroundCountingTime
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: backgroundCountingTime
      schema:name:
        const: Background Counting Time
      ada:dataType:
        const: number
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: M
      schema:defaultValue:
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - schema:defaultValue
  epma_beamCurrent:
    title: Beam Current
    description: Probe current in nanoamperes (nA). Often varies by phase type or
      target species; record the procedure-standard value(s).
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/beamCurrent
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: beamCurrent
      schema:name:
        const: Beam Current
      ada:dataType:
        const: number
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: M
      schema:defaultValue:
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - schema:defaultValue
  epma_beamDamageMinimization:
    title: Beam Damage Minimization
    description: Measures taken to minimize beam damage, particularly volatilization
      or migration of Na, K, F, and Cl in hydrous minerals, glasses, feldspars, phosphates,
      and carbonates. Document approach, beam conditions used, and phases for which
      it was applied.
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/beamDamageMinimization
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: beamDamageMinimization
      schema:name:
        const: Beam Damage Minimization
      ada:dataType:
        const: string
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: R
      schema:defaultValue:
        type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
  epma_beamDiameter:
    title: Beam Diameter
    description: Diameter of the electron beam in micrometers. 0 indicates a fully
      focused beam. Document defocused diameter when used to minimize beam damage
      or improve spatial averaging for beam-sensitive phases.
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/beamDiameter
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: beamDiameter
      schema:name:
        const: Beam Diameter
      ada:dataType:
        const: number
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: M
      schema:defaultValue:
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - schema:defaultValue
  epma_beamMode:
    title: Beam Mode
    description: Whether the electron beam was operated as a stationary focused spot,
      defocused to a specified diameter, or rastered over a small area during a single-point
      analysis. Must be consistent with the Beam Diameter and Beam Raster Dimensions
      fields. For mapping, beam scanning is controlled by Step Size / Pixel Size and
      Stage Scan vs. Beam Scan instead.
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/beamMode
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: beamMode
      schema:name:
        const: Beam Mode
      ada:dataType:
        const: string
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: true
      ada:tier:
        const: M
      schema:inDefinedTermSet:
        const:
          '@id': ada:vocab/beam-mode
      schema:defaultValue:
        type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - schema:defaultValue
  epma_beamRasterDimensions:
    title: Beam Raster Dimensions
    description: "Dimensions of the small area over which the beam is rastered at
      a single analysis point, reported as width \xD7 height in \xB5m. Applicable
      when Beam Mode = Rastered; defines the effective spatial footprint of the measurement.
      Not applicable when mapping."
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/beamRasterDimensions
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: beamRasterDimensions
      schema:name:
        const: Beam Raster Dimensions
      ada:dataType:
        const: number
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: R
      schema:defaultValue:
        anyOf:
        - type: number
        - type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
  epma_calibrationStandard:
    title: Calibration Standard
    description: "The reference material against which each target species is calibrated
      in each target material, converting raw signal intensities to concentrations,
      or anchoring an isotope ratio as the bracketing standard. Name an entry in Reference
      Materials. Where calibration instead uses the vendor's stored library or theoretical
      response factors rather than measured reference materials \u2014 'standardless'
      or 'semi-quantitative' quantification \u2014 record that here, naming the library
      or model used. 'None' means no calibration was performed at all, which is a
      different answer."
    type: object
    properties:
      '@id':
        const: ada:targetMaterialColumn/epmaTAPP/calibrationStandard
      '@type':
        const:
        - schema:PropertyValueSpecification
      schema:valueName:
        const: calibrationStandard
      schema:name:
        const: Calibration Standard
      ada:dataType:
        const: string
      schema:readonlyValue:
        const: false
      ada:tier:
        const: M
      schema:defaultValue:
        type: string
    required:
    - '@id'
    - '@type'
    - schema:valueName
    - schema:name
    - ada:dataType
    - schema:defaultValue
  epma_peakCountingTime:

    description: Time spent counting X-ray intensity at the peak position, in seconds.

    type: object
    properties:
